title: 3Jane PYTLocker Security Review
protocolOverview: PYTLocker permanently locks Pendle Yield Tokens and distributes harvested yield to depositors using reward-per-share accounting.
auditScope: This audit covers 1 smart contract totaling approximately 155 lines ofSolidity code across 2 days of review.
overallAssessment: The reviewed contract is compact and generally straightforward, but it has meaningful integration risk because multiple Pendle markets, SY balances, payout assets, and market-specific redemption semantics are multiplexed through a single contract.

evaluations.description: Centralized owner actions remain important for PYTLocker market onboarding, market caps, and sweep behavior.
The core reward-per-share accounting is simple and includes remainder handling

The contract is small, but PYTLocker combines custody and accounting for multiple externally-defined Pendle markets in one contract, which increases integration complexity and makes market isolation important.
The contract relies on OpenZeppelin primitives for ownership, safe transfers, math, and reentrancy guards.
The owner can configure supported YT markets, set market caps, and sweep non-protected tokens.
The code includes clear inline documentation for the core PYTLocker flow.

The repository includes unit, fork, and invariant tests for PYTLocker. However, the existing handler and mocks primarily model 1:1 SY behavior and do not fully cover real Pendle edge cases such as shared SY balances, non-1:1 wrappers, and rebasing payout assets.

issues.title: Shared SY balances can be credited to the wrong YT market
Direct asset inflows are ignored by harvest accounting and cannot be swept
